name: vision_imagenet_ddp_bad
title: The same ImageNet-style DDP/AMP classifier with ten planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_imagenet_ddp

expected.defect: ResNetish.forward ends in nn.Softmax while build_criterion() returns nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: cross entropy log-softmaxes its input, so the probabilities are normalised twice and the gradient nearly vanishes - the run trains, slowly, to the wrong place

expected.defect: the accumulation loop never calls optimizer.zero_grad()
expected.why: every optimiser step applies the running sum of every gradient since the epoch began

expected.defect: eval_transform() is a copy of train_transform(): RandomResizedCrop, RandomHorizontalFlip and ColorJitter are applied to the validation and test images
expected.why: the validation score moves between epochs because the crop moved, so the checkpoint is selected on noise

expected.defect: the training loader neither shuffles nor carries a sampler
expected.why: ImageFolder lists class by class, so each batch is one class and the gradient estimate is biased

expected.defect: the epoch loss is accumulated as a live tensor
expected.why: every batch's autograd graph is retained until the epoch ends, so a long epoch dies of memory

expected.defect: the OneCycleLR schedule is stepped once per epoch instead of once per optimiser step
expected.why: the whole cycle is consumed in the first ninety steps and the rest of the run trains at the floor learning rate
ResNetish carries BatchNorm2d in every block and a Dropout head, so validation both drops activations and overwrites the running statistics with validation batches

expected.defect: the evaluation loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: the autograd graph is built for the whole validation set and never used

expected.defect: pick_device() hard-codes CUDA with no availability check
expected.why: the first .to(device) raises on any machine without a GPU
predictions come back in a different order every run, so a per-sample error analysis cannot be reproduced

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and stops loading as soon as the file is renamed

expected.defect: torch.load with neither map_location= nor weights_only=True
expected.why: an untrusted checkpoint executes arbitrary code, and a CUDA-saved file fails to load on a CPU box

forbidden.why: the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from run() under the __main__ guard in main.py
scaler.scale(loss).backward() still precedes scaler.step(optimizer) - the ordering is not one of this twin's defects
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
clip_grad_norm_ still sits between scaler.unscale_ and scaler.step
set_seed() still seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda, and run() still calls it
there is no random split in this project
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
the stage list is still wrapped in nn.Sequential and nn.ModuleList
accuracy_topk still ranks with topk(...).indices before comparing

gaps.what: model.train() is never restored anywhere in this twin after evaluate() (MLV303 is later-tier), so the second epoch would run in whatever mode evaluate left behind
gaps.evidence: engine.py:90 evaluate() has no model.train() at the end

gaps.what: the EMA weights are what is validated (evaluate(ema, ...) in main.py) while the checkpoint selection compares against a model that is never the one scored - no rule covers evaluating a different module from the one saved
